text: Marswalk Gale. One map for walking on Mars.
Real terrain of Mount Sharp, two kilometers wide, with the path Curiosity actually drove.
Toggle layers. Slope, derived from HiRISE elevation. Night thermal from Mars Odyssey. And a modeled walk back time to the habitat.
It orders the science stops and finds the safest path around steep slopes. Switch a stop off, and the plan updates at once.
A solar event. The fastest route back to the habitat appears instantly.
Ask TARS for a seventy-five percent oxygen reserve. It drops one stop and replans the walk.
Step into the helmet view. Heading, oxygen and return margin stay in sight. At the stop, see a real Curiosity Navcam photo taken from that spot.
Observation, derived, or model. Oxygen and timing are estimates, never measurements. Marswalk Gale.
